title: YOLO
description: Single-pass real-time object detection model predicting class and bounding coordinates in one evaluation.
name: YOLO
summary: YOLO (You Only Look Once) frames object detection as a single regression problem, straight from image pixels to bounding box coordinates and class probabilities, achieving high-speed inference.
use_when: Implementing real-time object detection systems on edge devices or high-throughput servers.
avoid_when: Detecting extremely small, clustered objects where multi-stage region-based detectors perform better.
pros: Extremely high inference speed, easily reaching real-time rates (60+ FPS).
Global context modeling reduces background false positive errors.
Unified pipeline makes it easy to train and optimize end-to-end.
cons: Struggles to detect small objects appearing in groups or clusters.
Higher localization error rates compared to slower multi-stage models (R-CNN).
Generalization degradation on irregular or extreme aspect-ratio shapes.

key_hyperparams.name: confidence_threshold
key_hyperparams.note: Minimum confidence threshold score required to retain bounding box predictions.
